elements.name: Svirfneblin Magic
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Svirfneblin.

You have inherited the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors. This ability allows you to cast nondetection on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast each of the following spells once with this ability: blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Half-Elf Variant (Keen Senses)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Half-Elf.

You forgo the Skill Versatility trait and instead take the elf trait Keen Senses (proficiency in the Perception skill).

Workaround: Take this feat, then manually remove Skill Versatility from your sheet.

elements.name: Half-Elf Variant (Wood Elf Descent)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Half-Elf.

You forgo the Skill Versatility trait and instead choose one of the wood elf's Elf Weapon Training, Fleet of Foot, or Mask of the Wild traits.

- Elf Weapon Training: proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows.
- Fleet of Foot: your base walking speed increases to 35 feet.
- Mask of the Wild: you can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, or other natural phenomena.

Workaround: Take this feat, then manually remove Skill Versatility from your sheet and manually apply whichever of the three you choose.

elements.name: Half-Elf Variant (Moon Elf Descent)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Half-Elf.

You forgo the Skill Versatility trait and instead choose one of the high elf's Elf Weapon Training or Cantrip traits.

- Elf Weapon Training: proficiency with longswords, shortswords, shortbows, and longbows.
- Cantrip: you know one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability for it.

Workaround: Take this feat, then manually remove Skill Versatility from your sheet and manually apply whichever of the two you choose.

elements.name: Half-Elf Variant (Drow Descent)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Half-Elf.

You forgo the Skill Versatility trait and instead take the drow's Drow Magic trait: you know the dancing lights cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell once per day. When you reach 5th level, you can also cast the darkness spell once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

Workaround: Take this feat, then manually remove Skill Versatility from your sheet.

elements.name: Half-Elf Variant (Aquatic Heritage)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Half-Elf.

You forgo the Skill Versatility trait and instead gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.

Workaround: Take this feat, then manually remove Skill Versatility from your sheet.

elements.name: Feral Tiefling (Devil's Tongue)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Tiefling.

You are a feral tiefling rather than a standard tiefling of Asmodeus's bloodline. Apply the following adjustments manually to your sheet:

1. Change your ability score increase to +2 Dexterity, +1 Intelligence (instead of the standard +2 Charisma, +1 Intelligence).
2. Remove the Infernal Legacy trait.
3. Take this feat to gain the feral trait described below.

Devil's Tongue. You know the vicious mockery cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the charm person spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the enthrall spell once with this trait. You must finish a long rest to cast these spells once again with this trait. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them.

elements.name: Feral Tiefling (Hellfire)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Tiefling.

You are a feral tiefling rather than a standard tiefling of Asmodeus's bloodline. Apply the following adjustments manually to your sheet:

1. Change your ability score increase to +2 Dexterity, +1 Intelligence (instead of the standard +2 Charisma, +1 Intelligence).
2. Remove the Infernal Legacy trait.
3. Take this feat to gain the feral trait described below.

Hellfire. You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the burning hands spell once per day as a 2nd-level spell. Once you reach 5th level, you can also cast the darkness spell once per day. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

elements.name: Feral Tiefling (Winged)
elements.desc:
Prerequisite: Tiefling.

You are a feral tiefling rather than a standard tiefling of Asmodeus's bloodline. Apply the following adjustments manually to your sheet:

1. Change your ability score increase to +2 Dexterity, +1 Intelligence (instead of the standard +2 Charisma, +1 Intelligence).
2. Remove the Infernal Legacy trait.

Winged. You have bat-like wings sprouting from your shoulder blades. You have a flying speed of 30 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.
